messages:
Maria C: Heads-up — kicking off a small canary for release v2026.03.18 in prod-us-east-1 (5%). Will watch latency, errors, and routing. @Dom can you share the backout anchors?

deploy-bot: :rocket: canary started — release=v2026.03.18 env=prod-us-east-1 cohort=canary(5%) id=cb-3123456789 link=https://deploys.internal/runs/cb-3123456789

Dom: Backout runbook here: https://confluence.redwoodinc/ops/backout-v2026.03.18 — TL;DR criteria to abort: error_rate > 2% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency spike > 1200ms for 5m OR KV cache evictions > baseline x3. Steps: pause rollout, pin traffic to previous image, roll forward flag off, and clear local caches.

Jordan: Copy. I'll be on metrics. If I see error spikes I'll pause. Who's owning the pin?

Nick: I can run the pin if needed. Pin command is below — tested in staging: 
```
# pin to previous stable
./deployctl pin --service=api --version=v2026.03.17 --env=prod-us-east-1
kubectl rollout pause deployment/api -n prod
```

Priya: Also note: if we pin, we need to trigger the release-note rollback blurb and notify support channels. I'll draft the template now.

Dom: Addendum: If we abort because of latency, do NOT immediately scale down pods. Let the system stabilize then pin. If the KV cache is the issue, run: `sync-kv --shard=all --ttl=0` (run with SRE present).

Release Manager: I'm standing by to update customer-facing release notes and the internal incident doc. Priya — send me the prefilled rollback note and I'll post to #announcements if we do an official rollback.

Maria C: Noted. Canary metrics look normal at +6m. Proceeding to 25% in 10m if no alerts.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: cohort=extended(25%) in 600s. Will post update at each step.

Jordan: I'll set an alert on the error burn rate and p95 channels. If triggered I'll call an abort and ping @Nick and @Dom. :thumbsup:

Nick: Ready. I'll keep the pin command at hand and have credentials open.

Priya: Draft rollback note (internal): "Rolled back v2026.03.18 to v2026.03.17 due to canary p95 > 1200ms. Customer impact: transient increased latency for some regions; mitigated by immediate pin. Follow-up: root cause investigation ongoing." Will send to Release Manager now.

Maria C: Canary passing at 12m, no anomalies. Proceeding with scheduled extend. Thanks team. :party_parrot:
